newsitem.title: UK: United Assurance ceo sells 1.5mln stg shares.
newsitem.headline: United Assurance ceo sells 1.5mln stg shares.

text.p: United Assurance, which comprises the newly merged insurers United Friendly and Refuge Group, said on Friday that its chief executive George Mack and his spouse have sold shares in the company for nearly 1.5 million stg.
The transaction, which involved the sale of 312,000 shares at 475 pence more than halved Mack's holding in United Assurance to 263,000 ordinary shares or 0.08 percent of the issued capital.

The shares were acquired when Mack converted United Friendly stock bought for 623,000 stg under that company's executive share option scheme into a United Assurance holding under the terms of the merger with Refuge.
United Assurance announced the news after the stock market closed with shares in United ending half a penny lower at 477.
Nobody at the merged group's headquarters in Cheshire was immediately available for comment.
